name: ui-code-inspector
description: Guides adding a dev-only UI-to-source inspector to Vite React projects

interface.shortDescription: Click a rendered UI element to open its source line in your editor
interface.longDescription: Adds a dev-only inspector to Vite React projects: hold Alt/Option to enter inspect mode, hover to outline an element and see its source label, click to open file:line:column in your editor. Compile-time metadata injection plus a framework-neutral runtime, stripped from production builds.
defaultPrompt: Add a click-to-source UI inspector to this project.
Review the UI inspector setup in this repo.
